title: G4 Lens Zooms In
style: dark memphis phonk, 116 BPM, spoken intro, gritty baritone rap, chopped vocal hook, distorted 808 bass, tape stop samples, detuned bell loop, dry snare cracks, cowbell syncopation, DJ scratch cuts, mono drum bounce, lowpass breakdown, hard drop entrance, industrial electronic, post-punk rhythm section, analog tape saturation, mid-90s grit, claustrophobic energy, late night resolve
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
G4 lens engage
infrared on the stage
Peel back the suits
expose every cage
Coffee rings sweating
on a war-plan map
Finger on the border
while they practice their laugh

Folded little memos
passed hand to hand
Smiles like scenery
scripted and bland
We sit at the edge
of a borrowed sky
Leaders talking sideways
while the future says goodbye

[Chorus]
G4 lens zooms in
no spin, just skin
Every flinch, every grin
caught in the frame again
G4 lens zooms in
through glass and smoke
Every nod, every joke
every promise that broke

[Verse 2]
Investigate the table
every nod, every lie
Watch the way a pupil
shrinks when kids are mentioned and they sigh
Handshake, photo
flash in the hall
Backroom whisper
ink on the wall

We’re counting the seconds
till the script runs out
Till a hot mic hums
their hidden doubt
You can dim these lights
you can stage that win
But the cold eye’s open
and the G4 lens zooms in

[Chorus]
G4 lens zooms in
no spin, just skin
Every flinch, every grin
caught in the frame again
G4 lens zooms in
through glass and smoke
Every nod, every joke
every promise that broke
